You bear the manifestation of the Hearthfire both within and without. This manifestation appears in a form you choose, such as a small floating ember, a dancing flame, or a spirit. The manifestation sheds Bright Light for 10 feet and Dim Light for 10 additional feet. If this manifestation goes beyond 30 feet from you, it is extinguished. It can be summoned or dismissed as a Bonus Action. As a Reaction, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity and issue a command word, causing the Essence of the Hearth to transform into a flaming cloak. The cloak immediately grants you Temporary Hit Points equal to your Paladin level plus your spellcasting ability modifier. When you are hit by a melee attack, the creature takes 1d10 Fire damage in retaliation. This effect lasts until the Temporary Hit Points are depleted.
